disclaimer: Reminder reference only — NOT legal authority. Season dates, zones, and limits are set annually and can change. Always verify current regulations with the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation before hunting or trapping.

sources.title: 2026–2027 New York Hunting & Trapping Guide (NYSDEC)
sources.notes: DEC-published guide (digital edition via eregulations, DEC's official publisher). Trapping season WMU maps on print p.65; hunting seasons in pull-out summary and furbearer hunting pages. Archived locally in hidden_files/season-research/new-york/.

license_summary.trapping_license: All residents must have a valid trapping license in possession (exceptions: resident farm owners/lessees and immediate families trapping on farm lands they occupy and cultivate — not valid for beaver, otter, fisher, marten; Indigenous Peoples on reservation lands).
license_summary.hunting_furbearers: A hunting license is required to hunt furbearers; a trapping license alone does not allow hunting furbearers. Furbearers may be hunted with bow, crossbow, or firearm as specified in the guide.
license_summary.tags_seals: Bobcat, fisher, otter, and marten: complete a furbearer possession tag immediately upon reaching your vehicle/camp/home AND have the pelt or unskinned animal sealed by DEC within 10 days after the close of the season in the WMU where taken.

verification.confirmation_notes: 2026–2027 NYSDEC Hunting & Trapping Guide (final, current license year Sept 1, 2026–Aug 31, 2027). Trapping season dates and WMU zone assignments transcribed from the six color-coded season maps on print p.65 (PDF p.67), rendered at 250 DPI and read visually with 3x zooms on ambiguous units: 5T is light blue on the mink/muskrat map (Nov 10–Apr 7) but yellow on the bobcat map (Oct 25–Feb 15); 3R and 3S are closed (white) on the fisher/marten map while 3P is in the Nov 15–Dec 31 fisher-only zone. Hunting seasons from the guide pull-out summary and furbearer hunting pages (print pp. 59–60): raccoon/fox/skunk/opossum/weasel hunting Oct 25–Feb 15 (Nov 1–Feb 25 LI/NYC), weasel sunrise–sunset only; coyote hunting Oct 1–Mar 28 statewide except LI/NYC; bobcat hunting uses the same WMU zones as bobcat trapping (map-verified). Wolf protected/endangered status stated in the guide furbearer text (p.60).
known_gaps: Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in the NY guide; all marked scientific_name_verified=false. Weasel entry covers long-tailed and short-tailed weasels as grouped by the guide.

WMU zone memberships were read from color-coded maps (no textual WMU list in the guide); boundary units were zoom-verified but a map misread on a single WMU is possible — cross-check any single-WMU question against the guide map.
Snare prohibition, body-gripping trap size rules, and trap-check intervals are method regulations excluded per project scope; only the Adirondack bait restriction is carried as a warning.
No administrative-code (6 NYCRR) cross-check was performed; the guide is the DEC-published season authority.
